items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: Well I wondered if Jerome Carrington might have been playing piano with Jimmy Noon.

ctx.x: I can't recall who all was working. I think let's see. Let me try to think. Let's see. Who was working with Jimmy Noon. If my husband was here he could tell you better than I because he frequented those places more so than I did. And uh.
Well I wondered if Jerome Carrington might have been playing piano with Jimmy Noon. He may have.
